findings.title: Account save missing ownership verification

evidence.why: ID comes from request model binding (form/body), not verified against session user
No ownership check (e.g. WHERE user_id = ?) before save

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends POST /account/save with account.id set to User B's ID and modifies the data.
findings.impact: Modify another customer's account details (name, email, etc.).
findings.recommendation: Add ownership verification in the DAO or controller to ensure the account belongs to the current user before saving.

findings.title: Admin user delete missing role check

evidence.why: No @PreAuthorize annotation restricting access to ADMIN role
Allows deletion of any user ID without verifying admin status or ownership

findings.attack_scenario: User A sends POST /admin/users/{id}/delete with User B's ID. If no role check, User A can delete User B.
findings.impact: Delete another user's account (Privilege Escalation / BOLA).
findings.recommendation: Add @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") to restrict access to authorized administrators only.
